branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<short-kebab-description>, where type is one of feat, fix, chore, docs, perf, refactor or ui. Example: ui/ingame-theme, chore/add-agents-md. Personal experiments use mb/<description>.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits in the form '<type>: <lowercase summary>' with no scope, matching this repo's history (feat, fix, chore, docs, perf, refactor). Use 'done: <task title>' only when the commit completes a Notion task. Explain the why in the body when it is not obvious.

pullRequest.instructions: Summarize the change in a few bullets. Include a Testing section listing what was run (dotnet test, scripts/compile-check.ps1). State explicitly whether Simulation/ was touched and needs determinism review, whether networking changed and needs lockstep/desync review, and what needs manual verification in the Unity Editor.
